title: 第12章 玫瑰园中的小可怜
novel_title: 九恶妃每日一问，陛下驾崩了吗？
content_zh:
听着女人的话，秦然心中升起一股暖意。

    在面对其他妃子时，他能灵活应对游刃有余。

    可在面对徐若晗时，一些到了嘴边的花言巧语，竟有些不知如何开口了……

    女人放下剪刀，轻挽了下发丝，小跑着来到秦然身前，亲昵的抱住了他的胳膊。

    “江仙哥哥，发什么呆呢？”

    女人仰着头，静静看着他，琥珀色大眼睛弯成了月牙。

    清澈专注、静谧柔和。

    秦然挤出一抹笑容，带着女人朝不远处的凉亭走去，主动岔开话题。

    “西西，你这些玫瑰修剪的不错。”

    女人颇为得意的傲娇一笑。

    “那是当然～”

    秦然心中暗暗叹气。

    他了解这其中门道，也知道徐若晗为什么要种植香槟玫瑰。

    其实并非是她自己喜欢，而是年少时，云江仙曾随口提过那么一嘴罢了。

    为了云江仙高兴，一句随口之言，徐若晗却一直铭记并执行至今……

    “江仙哥哥，你脸色很不好，是昨晚没有睡好吗？”

    “不，不是。”

    秦然极不自然。

    不知为何，刚才他心中竟隐隐生出一丝愧疚感。

    徐若晗很自然地拉着秦然坐下。

    她拿起茶壶茶碗，熟练地泡起了茶，眼神灵动，手指灵活。

    “江仙哥哥，杯子里是用初茬儿玫瑰花瓣泡出的茶。”

    “这株玫瑰在去年入冬时差点冻死呢，我用棉被裹了它三晚才活下来～你快尝尝味道怎么样！”

    秦然端起茶杯，看着女人期待的眼神，忍不住摸了一下她的白嫩脸颊。

    女人仓促低头，耳尖绯红。

    秦然会心一笑，举杯一饮而尽。

    茶水入口透着清香，并无前两日喝的那些天地灵茶的灵气澎湃。

    但入腹后，却有一种柔和舒适之感。

    “很不错！”秦然由衷赞叹。

    “真的嘛？”

    “真的。”

    “江仙哥哥喜欢就好。这几天雨水多，我担心灵泉被雨水污浊了，都是提前取回来存放的，不然茶香会更好一些。”

    “西西辛苦了。”

    “一点也不辛苦～”女人笑容明媚。

    秦然拉起女人的手。

    这双手生得极为漂亮，但轻轻抚摸起来，并非特别光滑。

    在其掌心及指腹处，能清楚摸到一道道细微划痕。

    “西西，这是？”

    “没事啦，这是平常打理玫瑰园不小心划出的小口子。”

    秦然沉默了。
content_en:
Listening to the woman's words, Qin Ran felt warm in his heart.

    When facing other concubines, he can deal with them flexibly and with ease.

    But when facing Xu Ruohan, some of the sweet words that came to her lips were hard to say...

    The woman put down the scissors, gently pulled back her hair, trotted to Kieran, and hugged his arm affectionately.

    "Brother Jiang Xian, why are you so dazed?"

    The woman raised her head and looked at him quietly, her big amber eyes curved into crescent moons.

    Clear, focused, quiet and gentle.

    Qin Ran forced out a smile, led the woman towards the pavilion not far away, and took the initiative to change the topic.

    "Xixi, your roses are well pruned."

    The woman smiled proudly.

    "Of course~"

    Qin Ran sighed secretly in his heart.

    He knew the secrets and why Xu Ruohan planted champagne roses.

    In fact, it's not that she likes it, but that Yun Jiangxian mentioned it casually when she was young.

    For the sake of Yun Jiangxian's happiness, Xu Ruohan has always remembered and implemented this casual remark to this day...

    "Brother Jiang Xian, you look very bad. Is it because you didn't sleep last night?"

    "No, it's not."

    Qin Ran felt extremely unnatural.

    For some reason, there was a faint feeling of guilt in his heart just now.

    Xu Ruohan naturally pulled Qin Ran to sit down.

    She picked up the teapot and teacup and brewed tea skillfully, her eyes moving and her fingers nimble.

    "Brother Jiangxian, the cup is filled with tea made from the petals of first-crop roses."

    "This rose almost froze to death in the winter last year. I wrapped it in a quilt for three nights before it survived. Come and try it!"

    Kieran picked up the tea cup, looked at the woman's expectant eyes, and couldn't help but touch her white and tender cheek.

    The woman lowered her head hastily, the tips of her ears turning red.

    Qin Ran smiled knowingly, raised his glass and drank it all in one gulp.

    The tea has a refreshing fragrance in the mouth, but it does not have the surging spirit of the Tiandi Lingcha that I drank two days ago.

    But after entering the stomach, there is a soft and comfortable feeling.

    "Very good!" Qin Ran admired sincerely.

    "Really?"

    "Really."

    "Brother Jiang Xian, just like it. There has been a lot of rain these days, and I am worried that the spiritual spring will be polluted by the rain. I have taken it back and stored it in advance, otherwise the tea will have a better aroma."

    "Thank you for your hard work, Xixi."

    "It's not hard at all~" The woman smiled brightly.

    Kieran took the woman's hand.

    These hands are extremely beautiful, but when touched gently, they are not particularly smooth.

    On the palms and fingertips, tiny scratches can be clearly felt.

    "Xixi, what is this?"

    "It's okay, it's just a small hole I accidentally made while taking care of the rose garden."

    Qin Ran was silent.
title_en: Chapter 12 The Poor Little One in the Rose Garden
